steps: Peel and dice 500 g of butternut squash into 2 cm cubes; peel and finely dice 1 onion.
Mince 2 cloves of garlic and grate 5 g of fresh ginger.
Warm 20 ml of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until softened and translucent.
Stir in the garlic, fresh ginger, turmeric, and ground ginger; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the butternut squash, 400 g of cooked chickpeas, 400 ml of coconut milk, and 480 ml of vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 18 to 20 minutes, until the squash is completely tender.
Use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup, leaving some chickpeas and squash pieces whole.
Stir in 15 ml of lemon juice and serve warm in bowls.
Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze in portions up to 2 months.
